verdict.rationale: Meilisync is listed as an official integration that syncs databases into Meilisearch automatically, and a first-party Laravel Scout driver handles model-to-index syncing, so some connector-based ingestion is available without a custom pipeline. However, both are single thin mentions, and one community user reported that creating indexes and uploading documents took about a week of coding. Another reported the Rails gem falling out of sync with the server, which suggests connector-based ingestion still takes real work. Missing for 10: any official web crawler, detail on which databases and sources Meilisync supports, and documentation or hands-on corroboration of connector setup and reliability.
